full_text: The registered voters of the katipunan ng kabataan shall elect the chairman of the Sangguniang Kabataan who shall automatically serve as an ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Barangay upon his assumption to office. As such, he shall exercise the same powers, discharge the same duties and functions, and enjoy the same privileges as the regular Sangguniang Barangay members, and shall be the chairman of the committee on youth and sports development in the said sanggunian.
